summary: XORTX Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K disclosing the closing of a US$5 million public offering comprising 183,577 common shares and 2,475,997 pre-funded warrants at US$1.88 per unit. E.F. Hutton acted as placement agent, receiving a 4% cash commission. Proceeds are for working capital and corporate purposes, including investor relations. The offering was completed under an effective F-1 registration statement. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation, so the filing is classified as None.
